name: Antiochus Epiphanes
description: Surnamed Epiphanes, son of Antiochus the king and an hostage at Rome, who reigned in the hundred and thirty and seventh year of the kingdom of the Greeks, warred against Ptolemee king of Egypt, entered proudly into the sanctuary at Jerusalem and took away its vessels, set up the abomination of desolation upon the altar in the hundred forty and fifth year, and, after falling sick for grief in Persia and making Philip ruler of his realm to bring up his son Antiochus, died in the hundred forty and ninth year

points: Moreover king Antiochus wrote to his whole kingdom, that all should be one people. So what did King Antiochus write? That everyone should be one people. This was the first form of democracy.

So even this form of democracy under Antiochus, where he says, oh, let us all be one people, they all were one people under him. Everybody was one people under them, meaning you have got to follow his religion, you have got to follow his politics, you have got to follow his customs. That is what democracy is. And guess what, it is the same thing in America. The white man came and said, let us all be one people, and everybody has to follow whose religion? The white man's religion.

Moreover king Antiochus wrote to his whole kingdom, that all should be one people. All shall be one people: what is that called today? Democracy. The same thing Antiochus did, America did the same thing.

And every one should leave his laws: so all the heathen agreed according to the commandment of the king. Back then all the heathen left their laws and their customs and followed what Antiochus set up.

Let me tell you what democracy is: democracy is being subservient to the head. Who was the head there? Antiochus; all nations were subservient to him. Democracy is a form of slavery. After 1945 America went all over the world and pushed democracy; that is part of Pax Americana. Go to India: India has a democratic government. Go throughout the Caribbean islands, throughout South America: all of them are pushing democracy. Go to Africa: all these countries in Africa follow democracy. When did that begin? After colonialism, America and Europe came in and said, we are going to push our values on the whole world. Democracy is their values. Everybody wears suit jackets and ties; they all have senates and constitutions. Where did they get all that from? From Esau. Democracy is not equal rights and so forth; that is what was pushed through the craft, the deceit.
Antiochus wrote that all should be one people and leave their laws, and many Israelites consented to his religion. America demands the nations align with its interests or die.

note.label: Raising Cain: The Son of Perdition, Merchants, and Captive Nations

points: Antiochus wrote to his whole kingdom that all should be one people and every one should leave his laws. What does that look like today? One nation under God, democracy. We got that from the Greeks.

note.label: The Mind of Mattathias: Let's Search the Scriptures

points: Moreover king Antiochus wrote to his whole kingdom, that all should be one people.

After the death of Seleucus, when Antiochus called Epiphanes took the kingdom, Jason the brother of Onias laboured underhand to be high priest. This is his own blood brother. Not only does Onias have to deal with Simon of the tribe of Benjamin; his own blood brother is trying to take the priesthood from him. Put yourself in his sandals: his good friend Simon turned on him, and now his brother.

When there was gone forth a false rumour, as though Antiochus had been dead, Jason took at the least a thousand men and suddenly made an assault upon the city, and Menelaus fled into the castle. Now Menelaus is running from his one-time friend Jason, whose priesthood he took. But Jason slew his own citizens without mercy, thinking they had been his enemies, and not his countrymen, because he despised his own people.
